target_customer: Online merchants and subscription businesses wanting pay by bank checkout
problem: Card fees and failed card payments cost merchants; pay by bank is cheaper but poorly adopted.
business_model: Transaction fee (0.5% plus $0.30 per the company site)

founders.name: Chetan Kulhari
founders.background_notes: Only founder listed on the YC page; no background stated.

technical_complexity.rationale: Bank linking via Plaid plus ACH settlement and risk scoring is standard fintech engineering with credit risk.

defensibility.rationale: Built on Plaid and ACH rails that others can use.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Plaid, Adyen and Stripe all offer pay by bank now; no acquisition of Magic found.

market_need_then: No dated source on demand was found; in 2022 merchants paid card fees near 2.9% plus $0.30 per the company's own later comparison, and Plaid already offered bank linking, so need is plausible but not evidenced at founding.

brand_strength.rationale: Many unrelated products named Magic; no brand evidence.

outcome_analysis: Conflict: the YC page lists Magic as inactive but joinmagic.com is live, markets a pay by bank product and names General Catalyst and Soma Capital. The cause of any shutdown is not public, and no failure factor is assigned.
notes: Funding conflicts: VC Backed (data as of June 2023) says seed of $3.4M; Bounce Watch says $500K total with unknown seed amount; CB Insights says $9.4M total, unverified. Treated each as single-database. Competitor list empty: only undated 2025 and later sources found. Exit type unknown.
